decisive_items: Space-occupying lesion at left epidural site of T2-3
response.rationale: Champion C1 is directly supported by pathological confirmation of a vascular malformation and its epidural location. Runner-up R2 (hematoma) and R4 (abscess) are both contradicted by the same pathological finding. R2 is more plausible than R4 because the imaging features (mixed high/low signals on T2WI) are consistent with blood products, but it lacks a procedural history or anticoagulation use. R4 is less plausible due to absence of infectious signs and the presence of a confirmed vascular malformation.

rejected.why: Contradicted by confirmed vascular malformation; no clinical or laboratory evidence of infection.
